title: TabH2O: A Unified Foundation Model for Tabular Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2605.18383v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present TabH2O, a foundation model for tabular data that performs classification and regression in a single forward pass via in-context learning. TabH2O builds on the TabICL architecture with several key modifications: (1) unified training, a single model handles both classification and regression via a dual-head architecture, eliminating the need for separate models and reducing total pretraining cost; (2) single-stage pretraining, training stability improvements (bounded scalable softmax, inter-stage normalization, learnable residual scaling, logit soft-capping) eliminate the need for multi-stage curriculum learning, enabling training with full-length sequences from the start; and (3) noise-aware pretraining, synthetic datasets include explicit noise dimensions to teach the model robustness to irrelevant features. We evaluate TabH2O v1.1 (29.2M parameters) on the TALENT benchmark (300 datasets), where it achieves an average rank

translated_title: TabH2O：一种统一的表格数据基础模型
translated_abstract: 我们提出了TabH2O，一个用于表格数据的基础模型，它通过上下文学习在单次前向传播中同时执行分类和回归任务。TabH2O基于TabICL架构，并进行了几项关键改进：(1) 统一训练，通过双头架构使单一模型同时处理分类和回归，消除了对单独模型的需求，并降低了总预训练成本；(2) 单阶段预训练，通过训练稳定性改进（有界可扩展softmax、阶段间归一化、可学习残差缩放、logit软上限）消除了多阶段课程学习的需要，使模型从一开始就能使用全长序列进行训练；(3) 噪声感知预训练，合成数据集包含显式噪声维度，以教会模型对无关特征的鲁棒性。我们在TALENT基准（300个数据集）上评估了TabH2O v1.1（29.2M参数），它取得了平均排名...
tldr: TabH2O通过统一双头架构、单阶段训练和噪声感知预训练，实现了单一模型在表格数据上同时处理分类与回归，并显著提升性能。
en_tdlr: TabH2O achieves unified classification and regression on tabular data with a single model via dual-head architecture, single-stage training, and noise-aware pretraining, improving performance.
